title: The Layer That Can Take the Power Away: Torque Limits, Heat Derating, a Link Watchdog, an Emergency Stop, and Why Off Is Not Always Safe

questions.question: Why is off not always safe for a quadruped?
options: A robot switched off while standing collapses and lands hard

questions.question: A torque command of 40 N m was cut to:
questions.explanation: The peak the motor may give.

questions.question: Knees at 0.9 of their limit were derated to:
The emergency stop with the robot standing gave mode:
What does the layer take when several things are asked?
options: The highest mode, keeping the derating scale
questions.explanation: 2 with the knees hot and the link silent.

questions.question: Is this a certified safety function?
options: No: a model of the logic; a real one runs on separate hardware with a hardware stop
